messages:
Priya: Heads-up: we need to coordinate a base-image rebuild and a new attestation flow. Goal: every promoted image has a KMS-backed cosign attestation + SBOM before canary. Quick RBAC + runtime plan?
Devon: Ack. Proposal: grant image-builder@redwood-prod.svc the minimal KMS signer role scoped to the specific cryptoKey; do NOT grant keyAdmin or list/delete. Terraform change only on the single key resource.
Alex: For audit: enable KMS Admin activity logs + Storage Data Access for the registry writes. Sink both into security project -> SIEM index `images-signing-*`. Retain 1yr. Also alert on any IAM binding changes to that cryptoKey.
Julia: CI snippet to sign and attach attestation & SBOM:
```
build -> skopeo copy -> generate sbom (syft) -> COSIGN_EXPERIMENTAL=1 cosign sign --key "kms://projects/redwood/.../cryptoKeys/image-signer" --attestation-path att.json gcr.io/redwood/base:${TAG}
```
Also add `cosign verify --key ...` in canary pipeline to validate attestation + sbom hash before promotion.
Sam: Scan found openssl CVE-2025-1234 in a transitive layer. If we rebuild we should pick patched package. Id like a short canary: push signed image to canary, run full e2e + vuln scan, hold 24h before prod.
oncall-sre: If the signing key is suspected compromised, runtime denylist needed. We cant remove signatures; plan: maintain allowlist of approved digests in the admission controller and an emergency denylist for runtime enforcement. Document emergency key rotation steps in runbook.
Devon: Ill prepare the terraform IAM PR that binds `roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier` to the builder SA on the single key, plus a tiny runbook for emergency rotation and allowlist updates. PR target: EOD.
Priya: Action items: Devon = terraform PR + runbook; Julia = add cosign verify + sbom check in canary; Alex = create log sink + alert; Sam = post vuln diff after signed canary build; oncall-sre = review emergency denylist semantics. Reconvene if scan shows criticals. :thumbsup:
